metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the porch, one old line put back in the folder, the Bull's board, and the end of supper.

yesterday: Three days to Ash Wednesday. The glass was turned twice. You paid sixpence for firing and washing, till Lady Day. The loaf is a penny and a finger short.
The leaf in the folder is still the one line from Friday.
Supper was tenpence a head. Nashe paid a penny for one cup. You told him he was the page, and you left close on nine.
Tomorrow is The Two Gentlemen of Verona at the Cross Keys, at two of the clock. You are in it.
